policies.name: No Sale Without Contract
policies.rule: Any external sale, license, SaaS, API, SDK, or enterprise component must have an approved contract before activation.

policies.name: No License Without Customer
policies.rule: A license cannot be issued unless the customer is registered and commercially approved.

policies.name: No Billing Without Approval
policies.rule: Invoices must only be generated after contract approval and license activation.

policies.name: No False Partner or Customer Claim
policies.rule: Sheikha must not claim OpenAI, any AI company, or any enterprise as a customer, partner, or licensee without a signed agreement.

policies.name: Legal Review Before External Sale
policies.rule: External commercial licensing requires legal review before signing or activation.

policies.name: Human Commercial Approval
policies.rule: Pricing, license scope, renewal, cancellation, liability, and customer-facing terms require human approval.
